'''Eeook Mining and Reclamation''' was a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] company that once claimed the resources of the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[244Core]]. It competed with its rival, [[Tor-Ro-Bo Industries]], for the planet. Around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Sith–Imperial War]], the company was re-organized and re-named the '''Eeook Corporation'''.<ref name="Unknown Regions" />
